message: I jump out of bed. Something I can use as a weapon... There!
Grabbing the gorgeous chandelier I got for my birthday, I pressed my ear against the door.
Someone's there! Thieves are scary, but if I don't do it, who will!

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are *you* planning to do holding a thing like that!」

name: Azel
message: 「A weapon? Why would you need a weapon.」

name: Azel
message: 「A bandit, you say? Evildoers! Where are they!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what I thought, anyway, but it was just you, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How rude! Saying that to someone as favored by the gods as I am!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. Still, hearing noises by the front door this late at night, anyone would think that.」

name: Synn
message: 「We have eggs, tomatoes, onions, and sesame seeds.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not at all. Eggs, tomatoes, and onions are precious things.」

name: Azel
message: 「The food earlier... the tomato omelet and natto tofu... well... it was good.」

name: Synn
message: 「You kept saying 'so good, so good' while eating, after all.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sounds delicious! Now I'm kinda hungry! Make a midnight snack!」

name: Sally
message: 「Azel says she wants a midnight snack too!」

name: Azel
message: 「No. That's between us, don't mind it.」

name: Sally
message: 「What about the midnight snack, the midnight snack, the midnight snack!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I realized I hadn't thanked you for the meal earlier, so I came down to express my gratitude.」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up. Do you dislike being thanked by me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, just say it already. I'm sleepy.」
